shots.name: home
shots.caption: Start from a template, or pick up one of your designs.
shots.alt: OpenDesign's home page: a grid of templates above the recent designs.

shots.name: editor
shots.caption: Design on a canvas, with templates, brand kits, text, shapes and images on the left and the selected object's settings on the right.
shots.alt: The OpenDesign editor with a two-page carousel open.

shots.name: pages
shots.caption: A design can have several pages, exported together as one carousel PDF.
shots.alt: The editor with the pages strip open, showing both pages of a carousel.

shots.name: text-settings
shots.caption: Every text box can be a field filled from data, and can shrink to stay on its lines.
shots.alt: The settings of a selected text box: field name, shrink to fit, layer order, font and size.

shots.name: export
shots.caption: Export one page as a PNG at 2x, every page, or the whole carousel as one PDF.
shots.alt: The export menu: carousel PDF, this page and all pages.

shots.name: templates
shots.caption: Start from a template, including the designs you save as your own.
shots.alt: The editor's tool rail and templates panel.

shots.name: brand-kit
shots.caption: A brand kit keeps your colours, fonts and logos, and applies them to a page in one click.
shots.alt: The brand kit panel with a kit's colours, heading and body fonts.

shots.name: announcement
shots.caption: Landscape posts at LinkedIn's own size, 1200 by 627.
shots.alt: A landscape open-day announcement open in the editor.

shots.name: pages-video
shots.caption: Open a carousel's pages.
shots.alt: The editor with a two-page carousel open; the pages strip slides up and shows both pages.
